# Lawn Care and Snow Removal Experts

Lawn Care and Snow Removal Experts provides seasonal property care from Spruce Grove, Alberta. Services include lawn care and summer property maintenance, residential snow removal, spring and fall clean-up, and property clean-up and hauling for residential and commercial properties across the Greater Edmonton area.

## Business & Contact Information

- **Business name:** Lawn Care and Snow Removal Experts
- **Website:** https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com
- **Phone:** (587) 879-5296
- **Email:** lawncareandsnowremovalexperts@gmail.com
- **Address:** PO Box 3683, Spruce Grove, AB T7X 3A9, Canada
- **Service areas (Greater Edmonton):** Spruce Grove, Edmonton, St. Albert, Stony Plain, Leduc, Acheson, Beaumont, Sherwood Park
- **Residential snow removal focus areas:** Spruce Grove, Edmonton, and Stony Plain

## Core Services

### Lawn Care and Maintenance
Seasonal lawn care for residential and commercial properties, including mowing and trimming, edging, fertilizer application, aeration, power raking, overseeding, and lawn patch restoration.
- https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/lawn-care-and-maintenance

### Residential Snow Removal
Residential winter snow clearing for driveways, walkways, and access areas, including driveway clearing, walkway and sidewalk clearing, manual ice chipping, walkway safety maintenance, and ice melt application.
- https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/snow-removal-services

### Spring & Fall Clean-Up
Seasonal yard clean-up to prepare properties for changing weather, including leaf removal, yard debris removal, bed and hedge blowouts, light tree pruning, garden and landscape clean-up, and seasonal yard preparation.
- https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/spring-fall-clean-up

### Property Clean-Up & Hauling
Property clean-up and hauling for outdoor spaces, including yard clean-up, property debris removal, estate and bulk item removal, property clear-outs, and site clean-up and disposal.
- https://lawncareandsnowremovalexperts.com/services/property-cleanup-and-maintenance
